entities.name: Saur Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Saur Revolution, a transformative movement in Afghanistan (1978–1980). Emerged from Saur (April) Revolution brings the communist PDPA to power. Catalyzed Soviet Union invades Afghanistan with 100,000 troops and Geneva Accord.
